0022600172.text: The Lakers (5-2) host the Miami Heat (2-4) in the eighth game of Los Angeles' season, sitting 1st in the Pacific and 4th in the West after a win and a 3-1 home record, while Miami is 10th in the East after winning its last two. Los Angeles will be without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (out, foot), and Williams has averaged 11.3 points and 28.4 minutes per game this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 134-126 win in Miami on March 19, 2026.
